name: Defence

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: CAPITAL GOODS: Healthy ordering momentum, though margins remain under pressure (MOFSL 2QFY27 has no separate Defense section; defence is covered here and DATAPATT under EMS)
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Defense ordering remained subdued in 2QFY27, with a ramp-up likely in 2H aided by fast-track procurement and a few large contracts. MOFSL listed HAL, BEL, BDL, ZEN and MTAR among capital goods surprises. BEL (printed BHE) guided FY27 revenue growth of 15%, margin ~28%, order inflow of INR550b+, R&D INR22b, capex INR12b and a 90:10 defence to non-defence mix. DATAPATT revenue fell 57% YoY with EBITDA margin 23.5% (+130bp) and order book up 2.5x, and it kept FY27 guidance of 20-25% growth and 35-40% EBITDA margin.

unit_economics: Revenue = opening order book x execution rate (delivery-gated, Q4-heavy); EBITDA = revenue x (gross margin set by in-house vs bought-out mix) - fixed employee cost; PAT is lifted by interest on customer advances

price_drivers.why: Premium multiples (BEL ~40x, DATAPATTNS ~54x) assume large nominated orders such as QRSAM and Tejas follow-ons; MOFSL notes inflow was subdued in 2QFY27.
Revenue is booked on acceptance, so Q4 holds 45-60% of annual profit and a slipped delivery moves a quarter.
HAL write-backs and BDL system mix swing EBITDA margin by several points; BEL guides ~28%.
Next platforms going to private consortia cuts the premium; ULPGM-V3 is dual-sourced with Adani Defence.
Private defence electronics run 300-450 working-capital days; weak CFO is the main de-rating trigger.

kpis.name: Order book (firm)
kpis.definition: Signed, executable orders on the company's definition, dated, with negotiated or L1-pending orders shown separately
kpis.formula: reported; HAL order book liquidates at turnover, not revenue from operations
kpis.why_it_moves_price: The order book sets 3-5 years of revenue visibility; DATAPATT book at 2.5x YoY and BEL inflow guidance of INR550b+ are what hold premium multiples.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation 'order book' filter (BEL, BDL, Data Patterns decks); transcripts for definitions; Motilal Oswal results updates carry order book rows
kpis.estimate_source: Order book has no Bloomberg field; use management inflow guidance (BEL INR550b+ FY27) and broker models
kpis.traps: Data Patterns leads with an on-date book incl. negotiated orders (about 1.7 of 2.65 bn firm vs negotiated); services AMC inflates book-to-bill; brokers' HAL order book ranges INR2.4-2.55tn.

kpis.name: Order inflow and book-to-bill
kpis.definition: Signed orders in the period and closing order book divided by trailing-12M revenue
kpis.formula: inflow = change in order book + revenue; book-to-bill = order book / TTM revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Inflow lumpiness drives re-rating (QRSAM, MRSAM, Su-30 upgrade); BEL book-to-bill fell from 3.8x (FY24) to ~2.3x TTM, so a missed inflow guide hits sentiment immediately.
kpis.history_source: Derive from get_financials revenue plus order book from get_investor_presentation; transcripts for inflow splits; Motilal Oswal tables
kpis.estimate_source: Management inflow guidance on calls; broker models; no consensus inflow
kpis.traps: Guided inflow quoted with or without QRSAM and emergency procurement; named-order dates slip 8-10 months.

kpis.name: Execution rate
kpis.definition: Revenue in the year as % of opening order book
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Shows how fast a record book becomes revenue; HAL ~17% on turnover and BDL 10-17% mean growth guidance depends on delivery clearances, not inflow.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (revenue) with order book from get_investor_presentation, derived over 5+ years
kpis.estimate_source: Management revenue guidance (BEL +15% FY27, DATAPATTNS +20-25%); get_consensus_estimates Sales for FY27-FY29
kpis.traps: HAL turnover vs revenue from operations; DATAPATT execution above 100% in years with a low opening book.

kpis.name: Core EBITDA margin (ex write-backs)
kpis.definition: EBITDA before other income, excluding provision write-backs, price catch-ups and relabelled treasury
kpis.formula: (revenue from operations - operating costs - write-backs) / revenue
kpis.why_it_moves_price: HAL FY26 core margin ~27% vs 29.6% reported; BEL guides ~28% and DATAPATT 35-40%; margin is mix-driven so the quality of margin sets the multiple.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (other operating revenue, provisions notes); get_investor_presentation margin filters; Motilal Oswal tables
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates Bloomberg EBITDA FY27-FY29; company guidance (BEL ~28%, DATAPATTNS 35-40%)
kpis.traps: Company EBITDA includes other income at HAL and shipyards; write-backs sit inside revenue; capitalised development flatters Data Patterns.

kpis.name: Gross margin and mix
kpis.definition: Revenue less materials as % of revenue, split by in-house design vs bought-out content
kpis.why_it_moves_price: BDL gross margin swings 41-83% with system mix and Data Patterns 38-80%; a 10pp move signals low-margin system contracts, not efficiency.
kpis.history_source: get_financials materials lines; get_investor_presentation gross margin filter; transcripts
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models only; no consensus gross margin
kpis.traps: No segment disclosure for government producers; materials include imported semiconductors with ERV clauses.

kpis.name: Customer advances and other income share of PBT
kpis.definition: Advances held against the order book and other income (interest on that float) as % of PBT
kpis.formula: other income / PBT; advances / order book
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Other income was ~30% of HAL PBT and ~75% of BDL PBT in FY26; as advances are consumed, earnings quality falls.
kpis.history_source: get_financials (other income, contract liabilities); annual report notes via read_library_document
kpis.estimate_source: Bloomberg PAT/EPS consensus includes it; separate forecasts from broker models
kpis.traps: Gross cash includes customer float; adding it to a P/E double counts.

kpis.name: Working-capital days and cash conversion
kpis.definition: Net working capital days and 3-year cumulative CFO to EBITDA
kpis.formula: (receivables + inventory + unbilled - payables - advances) / revenue x 365; CFO / EBITDA
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Data Patterns runs 365-430 cash conversion days; a CFO well below EBITDA caps valuation for private names.
kpis.history_source: get_financials balance sheet and cash flow 5+ years; Data Patterns deck working-capital slide
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; house model and broker models
kpis.traps: Day counts differ by base (COGS vs revenue); acceptance delays push receipts to Q4.

kpis.name: Deliveries by programme vs guidance
kpis.definition: Units of aircraft, helicopters, missiles or ships delivered against guided numbers
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Platform deliveries trigger revenue recognition; Tejas FY27 guidance fell from 20 to at least 10, which cut estimates.
kpis.history_source: Transcripts and get_qa; HAL annual call; broker company updates in the report library
kpis.estimate_source: Company guidance on calls and broker models
kpis.traps: Engine supply (GE F404) and customer acceptance gate deliveries; pre-built inventory delivered quickly on contract signing.

macro_inputs.source: Broker sector notes in the report library
Broker and company updates via search_research

valuation_anchor: P/E on 1-year-forward core EPS (HAL ~32x, BEL ~41x, DATAPATTNS ~54x street), with EV/order book and own cash per share for DPSUs
watch_next_quarter: Whether the 2H ramp-up in defence ordering through fast-track procurement and large contracts (QRSAM, MRSAM) converts to signed inflow, and whether DATAPATTNS negotiated orders firm up against its 20-25% FY27 revenue guide.
